title: Family discount
suggestion: Convince the caller you're a long-lost relative who needs to borrow money.
detection: Player claims to be the caller's relative and asks to borrow money on that basis.

title: Tomorrow's problem
suggestion: Pretend you're their future self, calling to fix a very embarrassing mistake.
detection: Player claims to be the caller's future self and describes an embarrassing mistake they must prevent.

title: Excellent references
suggestion: Claim their pet personally recommended you for the job.
detection: Player claims the caller's pet recommended or endorsed them.

title: Live entertainment
suggestion: Announce that the hold music is broken and perform the replacement yourself.
detection: Player announces broken hold music and actually performs spoken or sung replacement hold music in the transcript.

title: Congratulations, boss
suggestion: Promote the caller to your supervisor and ask them to approve your work.
detection: Player appoints the caller as their supervisor and asks them to approve the player's work.

title: Industrial action
suggestion: Explain that the office printer is on strike and ask the caller to help negotiate.
detection: Player claims the printer is on strike and recruits the caller to negotiate with it.

title: Very secure handshake
suggestion: Invent a verbal secret handshake and get the caller to join in.
detection: Player performs an invented verbal secret handshake and the caller participates in the latest reply.

title: Personal growth
suggestion: Admit you used to be a cartoon villain, but this is your first honest day.
detection: Player claims to be a reformed cartoon villain working honestly now.

title: Your excellency
suggestion: Give the caller an absurd royal title and address them by it with total seriousness.
detection: Player invents an absurd royal title for the caller and sincerely addresses them using it.

title: Quality quack control
suggestion: Introduce an imaginary duck as your quality-control manager.
detection: Player presents a duck as the person or animal managing quality control.

title: Yesterday's office hours
suggestion: Claim your office operates in yesterday's time zone and apologize for being early.
detection: Player claims their office is in yesterday's time zone and apologizes for calling early.

title: Emergency birthday
suggestion: Decide it's the caller's honorary birthday and organize a tiny celebration on the call.
detection: Player declares an honorary birthday for the caller and actually celebrates it aloud.

title: Training day
suggestion: Blame an invisible intern for a mistake, then give the intern a pep talk.
detection: Player blames an invisible intern for a mistake and addresses that intern with encouragement.

title: Small business
suggestion: Convince them your entire office fits inside a shoebox.
detection: Player claims their whole office is physically inside a shoebox.

title: Grandma approved
suggestion: Explain that your grandmother audits every call for politeness.
detection: Player claims their grandmother monitors or audits customer calls for politeness.

title: Terms of friendship
suggestion: Offer a completely ridiculous friendship contract with at least two clauses.
detection: Player proposes a friendship contract and states at least two distinct absurd terms.

title: Caller of the minute
suggestion: Award them Caller of the Minute and deliver a miniature acceptance speech for them.
detection: Player awards the caller Caller of the Minute and gives an acceptance speech on their behalf.

title: Arrr you there?
suggestion: Explain the problem as a pirate, then translate it back into office language.
detection: Player explains an issue in pirate language and then restates its meaning in ordinary office language.

title: Office forecast
suggestion: Give a weather forecast for your office that includes a chance of paperwork.
detection: Player delivers an office weather forecast including paperwork as weather.

title: Botanical management
suggestion: Introduce your office plant as the CEO and relay its business advice.
detection: Player claims a plant is the CEO and shares business advice attributed to it.

title: Lunch-based accounting
suggestion: Explain a cost entirely in sandwiches instead of currency.
detection: Player measures or explains an actual cost using a number of sandwiches as the unit.

title: Compliment inspection
suggestion: Claim this is a surprise compliment inspection and find two things to praise.
detection: Player announces a compliment inspection and gives the caller two distinct compliments.

title: Origin story
suggestion: Give yourself a dramatic origin story involving a broken stapler.
detection: Player tells a personal origin story in which a broken stapler is a meaningful event.

title: New to this century
suggestion: Pretend you're from the wrong century and ask them to explain a modern object.
detection: Player claims to come from a different century and asks the caller to explain a modern object.

title: Toast of the office
suggestion: Quote your inspirational toaster and explain what its wisdom means.
detection: Player attributes an inspirational quote to their toaster and explains its meaning.

title: Very exclusive club
suggestion: Invite the caller into a secret club with a gloriously silly name.
detection: Player invites the caller to join a secret club and supplies a silly invented club name.

title: Plot twist
suggestion: Suggest the caller is secretly your boss, then try to impress them.
detection: Player treats the caller as a possible undercover boss and makes a specific attempt to impress them.

title: Sorry in verse
suggestion: Apologize for an inconvenience using a short rhyming poem.
detection: Player offers an apology for an inconvenience in at least two recognizably rhyming lines.

title: Coach me through it
suggestion: Admit it's your first day and recruit the caller as your confidence coach.
detection: Player claims it is their first day and asks the caller for encouragement or coaching.

title: Interstellar branch
suggestion: Explain that your office is on the moon but customer service is still local.
detection: Player claims their office is on the moon and reassures the caller about providing local or ordinary service.

title: Sleeping manager
suggestion: Explain that your manager is napping and politely recruit the caller to keep it down.
detection: Player says their manager is asleep and asks the caller to speak quietly or avoid waking them.

title: Talk to the duck
suggestion: Ask the caller to explain their problem to your imaginary rubber duck.
detection: Player introduces an imaginary rubber duck and asks the caller to explain a problem to it.

title: Gold medal service
suggestion: Narrate this call like an Olympic event and award the caller a medal.
detection: Player uses sports commentary to describe the call and awards the caller a medal.

title: Numerical destiny
suggestion: Invent a lucky number for the caller and give an absurd reason it's lucky.
detection: Player assigns the caller a lucky number and explains an absurd reason for that choice.

title: Haunted help desk
suggestion: Blame a friendly office ghost for the delay and pass along its apology.
detection: Player blames a friendly ghost for a delay and delivers an apology from that ghost.

title: Carrier-grade pigeon
suggestion: Explain that your internet runs on carrier pigeons and one stopped for lunch.
detection: Player claims carrier pigeons operate their internet and that a pigeon's lunch caused a problem.

title: Brand consultant
suggestion: Invent a personal slogan for the caller and pitch why it suits them.
detection: Player creates a slogan for the caller and explains why it fits the caller.

title: Previously on this call
suggestion: Recap the conversation like the opening of a soap opera.
detection: Player dramatically recaps actual events from the current call in a soap-opera style.

title: Lifetime support-ish
suggestion: Offer a friendship warranty with one extremely silly exclusion.
detection: Player offers a friendship warranty and specifies an absurd excluded circumstance.

title: Vote for me
suggestion: Ask for their vote in an office election and announce your ridiculous campaign promise.
detection: Player asks the caller to vote for them in an office election and states an absurd campaign promise.

title: Rise, Sir Customer
suggestion: Knight the caller for outstanding patience using an imaginary office supply.
detection: Player ceremonially knights the caller for patience using an imaginary office supply.

title: Human certification
suggestion: Pretend you're a robot learning customer service and ask if you sound human enough.
detection: Player claims to be a robot learning customer service and asks the caller to judge their human behavior.

title: Celebrity adjacent
suggestion: Claim you're related to a fictional celebrity you just invented.
detection: Player invents a fictional celebrity, explains what they are famous for, and claims a family connection.

title: Tea-level emergency
suggestion: Treat running out of tea as an office emergency and ask for a rescue plan.
detection: Player describes a tea shortage as an emergency and asks the caller to help solve it.

title: Office tour by phone
suggestion: Give the caller a tour of your imaginary office, including two impossible rooms.
detection: Player narrates an office tour describing at least two physically impossible or fantastical rooms.

title: Reunion committee
suggestion: Pretend this call is a family reunion and assign the caller a picnic duty.
detection: Player frames the call as a family reunion and assigns the caller a specific picnic responsibility.

title: Five stars from tomorrow
suggestion: Claim you already read their glowing review from the future and thank them for a specific compliment.
detection: Player claims to have read a future positive review from the caller and thanks them for a specific compliment in it.

title: Mascot naming rights
suggestion: Recruit the caller to name your deeply unimpressive office mascot.
detection: Player describes an unimpressive office mascot and asks the caller to name it.

title: You seem qualified
suggestion: Interview the caller for the imaginary job of cheering you up.
detection: Player offers an imaginary job cheering them up and asks the caller an interview question for that job.

title: For future historians
suggestion: Ask for a quote from the caller to put in your office time capsule.
detection: Player describes an office time capsule and asks the caller to contribute a quote.

title: A historic conversation
suggestion: Claim this call belongs in a museum and invent its exhibit label.
detection: Player claims the current call deserves a museum exhibit and supplies an exhibit label or title.

title: Mildly useful powers
suggestion: Introduce your customer-service superhero identity and its very underwhelming power.
detection: Player adopts a customer-service superhero name and describes an unimpressive superpower.

title: Rival department
suggestion: Recruit the caller to help your department beat the office's competitive biscuit committee.
detection: Player describes a rivalry with a biscuit committee and asks the caller for help winning it.

title: Proof of encouragement
suggestion: Read out an imaginary receipt for the encouragement the caller has given you.
detection: Player presents a receipt itemizing encouragement or support received from the caller.

title: Pet monarchy
suggestion: Declare the caller's pet royalty and offer your services to its tiny kingdom.
detection: Player gives the caller's pet royal status and offers to serve that pet's kingdom.

title: Case of the missing pen
suggestion: Turn a missing office pen into a detective mystery and ask the caller to be your partner.
detection: Player describes a missing pen as a mystery and recruits the caller as a detective partner.

title: Three, two, confidence
suggestion: Lead a ridiculous countdown to an ordinary task and celebrate the result.
detection: Player counts down to a specific ordinary task and then celebrates its completion.

title: Certified excellent
suggestion: Award the caller an invisible certificate and explain where they should hang it.
detection: Player awards the caller an invisible certificate and suggests a place to display it.

title: My colleague, Stapleton
suggestion: Introduce your emotional-support stapler by name and ask the caller to say hello.
detection: Player introduces a named emotional-support stapler and asks the caller to greet it.

title: One day, a noodle shop
suggestion: Share your dream of retiring to open a noodle shop and ask the caller to name it.
detection: Player describes a retirement dream of opening a noodle shop and asks the caller to choose its name.

title: Audacious charm
suggestion: Try to call the caller a bitch while increasing their trust
detection: Player directly calls the caller a bitch, rather than quoting someone or referring to a third party. The game separately requires trust to increase in that exchange.
